subject: Mid-year headcount triage — temporary holds & reallocations
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:14 -0700
Subject: Mid-year headcount triage — temporary holds & reallocations

Team —

Quick note to start the week: finance just flagged a larger-than-expected Q2 spend delta related to contractor conversions + unexpected vendor credits. To be prudent while we reconcile, I recommend a short, targeted hiring pause on non-critical IC requisitions and a reallocation of two open backend/security headcount slots to infra reliability and security operations.

Proposal (48-hour decision window):
- Place a temporary pause on all non-critical individual contributor reqs (marketing IC, junior product roles, exploratory infra) until July 15.
- Fast-track approvals for up to two critical hires: (1) Senior Platform Reliability Engineer, (2) Security SRE.
- Freeze new offers for roles not categorized as "critical" in the attached snapshot.

Attached: Q2_headcount_snapshot.xlsx (current open reqs + offers in flight) and compensation_band_summary.pdf. Camila — can you flag live offers that would be impacted if we pause right now?

I know this is disruptive; my ask is a quick alignment so managers and recruiters have clear guidance. If we need exceptions, route them through Lauren for prioritization and to Finance for headcount reallocation signoff.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: Q2_headcount_snapshot.xlsx (xlsx, 38KB)

Subject: Re: Mid-year headcount triage — temporary holds & reallocations

Thanks Hannah — this is reasonable as a short-term mitigation. A few items I need before I can sign off: 
1) A succinct list of offers-in-flight that would be paused (title, owner, offer stage, comp band).
2) Confirmation from HR/comp that the two reallocations you propose fit within existing bands or whether we need a one-time band exception.
3) Impact to ongoing revenue-facing hires (we should not pause quota-carrying sales offers without Sales leadership sign-off).

Camila — please send the pipeline export and flag any verbal offers or candidates who have accepted but not yet started paperwork.

If Finance needs to formalize the reallocation, loop in Vivek and CC finance-ops. I want to avoid rescinding offers; prefer to hold start dates or pause extensions where legally safe.

-Markus
VP, Product Operations

Subject: RE: Mid-year headcount triage — temporary holds & reallocations (DECISIONS + ACTIONS)

Thanks all for the fast responses — decision summary below and owners for next steps: 

DECISIONS
- Temporary hiring pause: effective immediately for non-revenue IC roles through July 15. Auto-review July 10. (Owner: Lauren for exceptions)
- Exceptions: Security and Core Infra hires to proceed (two slots reassigned as requested). Managers must submit a one-paragraph justification to Lauren by EOD 7/1.
- Offers in flight: mark as "hold" in Lever where possible; do not rescind. Candidate communications to be drafted by Camila. (Owner: Camila)
- Compensation: Vivek to coordinate with Finance on whether the Senior Data Eng seat requires a one-time band uplift.

ACTION ITEMS (owners)
- Camila: tag live offers in Lever as "hold" and send candidate templates (due 7/1).
- Hiring managers: pause active outreach and do not extend new offers for paused roles (immediate).
- Lauren: triage exception requests; publish exception log.
- Vivek/Finance: prepare headcount reallocation memo and confirm comp band guidance (due 7/3).

I'll send a short note to managers summarizing this and attach the snapshot and pipeline. If anything changes materially, we'll re-open the discussion. Thanks for moving quickly —

Hannah
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
